title: Uniqueness of computed output
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state deterministic oracle Turing machine, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $x,w,w'$ be words over its alphabet. If $M$ on input $x$ with oracle $O$ halts with output $w$ after $t$ steps and also halts with output $w'$ after $t'$ steps, then $w=w'$.
